title: File:Persiluhr in Wismar.jpg
desc: The Persil clock (Persiluhr) in Wismar, Germany (located at the Lindengarten park / Bahnhofstraße). This free-standing, four-sided advertising and timepiece structure stands as a prime example of the beginnings of modern brand-name branding, outdoor advertising, and urban hygiene and social history
